notes: Yarok, the Desecrated (CR 603.2d; gate round W3's review, MINOR-6). Printed: 'If a permanent entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.' Seat 0 casts Shock beside Kykar, Wind's Fury: Kykar's 'Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.' is caused by a cast, no entering, so it triggers once: one Spirit. Yarok with his cause dropped would double every trigger of seat 0's permanents (two Spirits), a G3 mutant (tools/cards/gates.py, 'extra-trigger cause dropped') the other two Yarok packs do not kill. Shock deals 2 to seat 1.
